coordinatePolicy.note: Mars Trek layers are visual context. MarsWalk can consume a separately processed, geographically aligned USGS CTX DTM grid in the same Jezero footprint; synthetic terrain is retained only as an explicit fallback when the real grid is absent.

sources.name: MGS MOLA + Mars Express HRSC Color Hillshade Blend
sources.access: NASA/JPL Mars Trek WMTS REST tiles
sources.limitations: not used to derive local slope, terrain cost, science score, or EVA safety

sources.name: MGS MOLA Global Color Hillshade
sources.access: NASA/JPL Mars Trek WMTS REST tiles
sources.limitations: color hillshade is a visualization, not the numeric MEGDR topography grid

sources.name: Viking VIS Global Color Mosaic / MDIM 2.1
sources.access: NASA/JPL Mars Trek WMTS REST tiles
sources.limitations: imagery cannot by itself support terrain-risk or mineral measurements

sources.name: Mars 2020 Terrain Relative Navigation CTX DTM Mosaic
sources.status: verified source / real terrain pipeline implemented / official raster build blocked in this ChatGPT sandbox by outbound DNS
sources.access: GeoTIFF from USGS Astrogeology/ASC PDS services; pipeline/fetch_ctx_dtm.py downloads the exact file only
sources.classification: processed stereo digital terrain model; elevation source-derived, slope and 100 m cell statistics derived
sources.coverage: 77.1605°E–77.699°E, 18.211°N–18.7212°N; contains the configured MarsWalk 5 km route footprint
sources.nominalResolution: 20 m posts/pixels; 100 m route-cell spacing aggregates these samples and does not create new detail
sources.crs: Mars equirectangular/equidistant cylindrical, lat_ts=0°, lon_0=0°, sphere R=3,396,190 m; planetocentric latitude; east-positive longitude
sources.verticalUnits: metres; MOLA-referenced/control context per USGS release metadata
sources.websiteUse: primary MarsWalk elevation input when data/terrain_grid.json is generated; slope, passability and terrain-cost derive from this DTM
sources.limitations: terrain-cost thresholds are project model assumptions, not NASA EVA safety standards; science priority remains a separate simulation; source build must be run before real mode is active

sources.name: HiRISE Digital Terrain Model
sources.status: verified source exists / not yet integrated into MarsWalk
sources.access: PDS .IMG DTM with embedded label; downloadable product
sources.typicalResolution: 1–2 m post spacing from 0.25–0.5 m/pixel input images
sources.limitations: current embedded MarsWalk 100 m grid was not generated from a selected Jezero HiRISE DTM

sources.name: CRISM Map-Projected Targeted Reduced Data Record (MTRDR)
sources.status: verified source exists / not yet integrated into MarsWalk
sources.access: PDS product volumes; MTRDR spectral cube + summary-parameter products
sources.limitations: current science score/mineral labels in routing grid are synthetic demonstration values

sources.name: THEMIS infrared / thermal-inertia context
sources.status: verified instrument/source family / not yet integrated into MarsWalk
sources.access: THEMIS/PDS products; exact Jezero thermal-inertia product still requires coverage/product audit
sources.classification: source observations and derived products depending selected product
sources.limitations: current demo sand values are synthetic

sources.name: MOLA Mission Experiment Gridded Data Record (MEGDR)
sources.status: verified source / not used for rover-scale slope
sources.limitations: too coarse for current rover-scale terrain-cost model

sources.name: Mars Environmental Dynamics Analyzer archive
sources.status: verified archive / values intentionally not loaded
sources.access: PDS calibrated/derived CSV tables; SkyCam binary images
sources.classification: historical observation / calibrated or derived archive product
sources.websiteUse: current UI displays Unknown; planned historical replay only
sources.limitations: future use must be labelled historical/replayed data, not live Mars weather

sources.name: MarsWalk synthetic terrain fallback grid
sources.websiteUse: fallback routing terrain only when data/terrain_grid.json is unavailable or not marked terrain_mode=real
sources.limitations: never presented as NASA-derived; automatically superseded by a valid processed USGS CTX terrain grid

sources.name: Embedded rover-story overlay
sources.limitations: not a spatially verified Perseverance traverse

sources.name: Radiation at Jezero
sources.limitations: build does not substitute Gale MSL RAD as a Jezero measurement
